messages.高めの速度と挑発値で敵の攻撃に割り込み、防御レベル増加で受け止めるタンク。S3「: A tank who cuts in on enemy attacks with fairly high Speed and Aggro and absorbs them with Defense Level Up. S3 Guardian hands Defense Power Up and Defense Level Up to all allies, also strengthening allies' Defense skills.
messages.速度と挑発値: 速度は4〜8。S1「立ち向かう」はⅡコインの表面的中時に次のター: **Speed and Aggro**: His Speed is 4–8. S1 Standoff grants 2 Haste next turn on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit (1 at lower Uptie). S2 Flexible Suppression adds +3 Aggro to its slot next turn on use (+2 at lower Uptie), and the Defense skill The Best Defense adds +5 Aggro to its slot next turn on use.
messages.防御レベル増加を積む: S1は使用時に+2。S1でマッチに敗北すると(防御レベル: **Stacking Defense Level Up**: S1 grants +2 on use. Losing a Clash with S1 grants Shield of (Defense Level Up×5) (×3 at lower Uptie) and +2 next turn (+1 at lower Uptie). S2 grants +3 on use (+2 at lower Uptie) and +1 next turn on each Heads Hit with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ. The combat passive Combat Shield (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants +2 at Combat Start if he is targeted by 2 or more attacks, and +3 below 50% HP.
messages.防御レベル増加で強化: S2は6以上でマッチ威力+1、Ⅳコインのダメージ量+40: **Bonuses from Defense Level Up**: At 6 or more, S2 gains +1 Clash Power and Coin Ⅳ deals +40% damage (+20%/+30% by Uptie). S3 gains +1 Coin Power per 6 (up to 3; +1 at 6 or more at lower Uptie) and +50% damage at 10 or more (+30% at lower Uptie). These conditions are somewhat demanding.
messages.S3「守護者」: 使用時に全味方へ守備威力増加2・防御レベル増加3。Ⅲコインの的: **S3 — Guardian**: On use, gives 2 Defense Power Up and 3 Defense Level Up to all allies. On Coin Ⅲ hit, gives 3 Defense Level Up to all allies next turn. Defense Power Up raises the Final Power of Defense skills, so the effect is large when combined with allies who use Defense skills.
messages.守備「最善の防御」: マッチ威力15〜20(低い段階では12〜17)。戦闘開始時: **Defense skill — The Best Defense**: Clash Power 15–20 (12–17 at lower Uptie). Grants Shield of (Defense Level Up×2) at Combat Start.
messages.サポートパッシブ「あなたの盾」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 体力最大値が: **Support passive — Your Shield (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: If the 1 ally with the highest max HP is targeted by 2 or more attacks, they gain 3 Defense Level Up.
messages.速度を活かして先に動き、S2や守備で挑発値を上げて攻撃を引き受ける。防御レベル増: Use his Speed to act first, raising Aggro with S2 or his Defense skill to take attacks. Defense Level Up is less effective than Protection against attacks of affinities he resists poorly. Time S3 for turns when allies set up their Defense skills. His Clash Power is not high, so supplement it with E.G.O. All of his skills are Slash, and in the Mirror Dungeon he is highly rated in Slash teams that have picked up Broken Greatsword.
